prefreeze_reserve_summary.note: Reserve counts are acquisition capacity only. They are not eligible-event counts and cannot be used to freeze the cohort until promotion blockers, cross-batch deduplication, issuer concentration, financing-window, single-asset, historical-universe, and point-in-time evidence requirements are resolved.

conference_other_primary_batch_01.note: Conference rows require verification of abstract/poster/oral first-public availability and cross-stratum deduplication before promotion.

negative_phase2_supplement_01.note: Negative status is based on prespecified clinical endpoint failure, not market performance. Supplement must be deduplicated against the primary Phase II reserve before master-registry inclusion.

sec_primary_from_github_runner.note: Targeted SEC documents remain usable through other access paths; zero runner-acquired candidates must not be interpreted as zero historical events.

clinicaltrials_current_records_from_gith.note: Research labels remain excluded from outcome truth. Historical ClinicalTrials record versions remain mandatory before clinical-event promotion.

historical_market_data_status.note: The connected SIP feed returned consolidated raw pre/post-split prices and a separate corporate-action record, compatible with leakage-safe reconstruction. No real frozen-cohort snapshot or outcome is yet complete.

blocking_findings: No authoritative frozen 120-event registry or cohort-manifest.json exists.
All five numerical stratum minima now have pre-freeze reserve capacity, but no reserve row is automatically eligible for the authoritative cohort.
The pre-freeze negative reserve is 43 candidate rows before deduplication and promotion; the final frozen cohort still must contain at least 40 verified negative underlying events.
Cross-batch deduplication and primary-stratum assignment remain incomplete, especially for conference/other disclosures that may overlap clinical program updates.
Historical ticker/CIK/security identity and exact first-public availability remain unresolved for many rows.
Financing/dilution T-90 through T+30 and single-asset status have not yet been resolved for enough candidates to satisfy the frozen >=20 requirements.
Historical BOE universe/investability status and point-in-time scientific, SEC, capital-structure, and valuation evidence have not yet been reconstructed for an eligible >=120-event registry.
Alpaca SIP raw bars plus separate corporate actions are a viable market-data route, but no real cohort has yet been reconstructed through that route.
No real 2025 holdout has been locked before outcome inspection.
required_action: Stop expanding strata unless promotion attrition requires replacements. Consolidate and deduplicate the 165-row pre-freeze reserve, resolve historical identity/timestamps/universe status, establish >=20 financing-window and >=20 single-asset cases, verify enough point-in-time evidence to yield >=120 eligible events with all frozen constraints, then freeze with seed 100100 before any stock-outcome inspection. Do not reduce requirements or alter BOE-1.0.0.
